name: node-react-template
description: Express + React + Docker project template with TODO example

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n api,ui -c cyan,green "WEB_PORT=3000 NODE_ENV=development tsx watch src/index.ts" "cd web && npx vite"
scripts.build:web: cd web && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:web
